name: Uzbekistan

nso.name: National Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan on Statistics (Milliy statistika qo'mitasi / Нацкомстат)

latest_census.notes: First census since 1989, conducted 15 Jan - 28 Feb 2026 (Presidential decree of 19 Sep 2025), partly online via census.stat.uz with OneID. Nationality (ethnicity) was asked and national results are out: 89.4% Uzbek, 3.3% Tajik, 2.2% Karakalpak, 1.8% Kazakh, 1.6% Russian, 0.6% Kyrgyz, 0.5% Turkmen, 0.6% other; total 39,047,321 (kun.uz 30 Jun 2026; gazeta.uz interview 31 Mar 2026). Whether native language was asked could not be confirmed from search snippets (they only say respondents were interviewed in the state language or their native language, which is interview language, not a question). No search result mentioned a religion question; Soviet-lineage censuses do not usually ask it, but this is not established. Regional breakdowns of nationality were not found in any search result.

subnational_sources.title: Census 2026 results (Перепись - 2026) -- national nationality composition; regional tables not yet located
subnational_sources.evidence: Search results (gov.uz 'Перепись - 2026', kun.uz 'Census: Ethnic Uzbeks account for nearly 90%', gazeta.uz 'Большое интервью с Нацкомстатом о результатах переписи') give national shares and regional population totals (Samarkand 4,379.8k, Fergana 4,223.0k, Kashkadarya 3,717.0k, Andijan 3,521.8k) but the summary explicitly says 'the search results do not contain detailed breakdowns of ethnic composition by individual regions'. Regional nationality tables, if published, would be on stat.uz or census.stat.uz.

tier_reason: A 2026 census with a nationality question exists and national results are published, but no search result surfaced a regional or district table, and the search budget ran out before stat.uz/census.stat.uz could be probed further.
recommended_action: Check stat.uz (Russian section 'Демография' and the census results section) and census.stat.uz for 'национальный состав постоянного населения' by region (14 = admin1: 12 viloyats + Karakalpakstan + Tashkent city) and by district/city (packet admin2 198). If the 2026 census regional tables are not yet out, look for Нацкомстат's annual register-based national-composition-by-region tables on stat.uz or data.egov.uz as an interim. Establish from the questionnaire whether native language was asked; if religion was not, declare it not_collected.

summary: Uzbekistan ran its first post-Soviet census in January-February 2026 and has published national nationality shares (89.4% Uzbek, 3.3% Tajik, 2.2% Karakalpak, 1.8% Kazakh, 1.6% Russian) and regional population totals, but no search result showed nationality by region or district, and whether language or religion were asked could not be confirmed. Tier D for now: the data almost certainly will exist at the 14-region level on stat.uz or census.stat.uz, and a runner should look there first, then at data.egov.uz for interim register-based composition tables. Nothing is currently filled.
